caption:
Repost other people's content ten or more times in 30 days and Instagram removes your account from recommendations entirely.

That's not a shadowban rumour. It came out of the originality update, and since April 30, 2026, accounts that mostly post other people's content in Reels, photos or carousels are out of recommendations. Your followers still see you. Strangers stop.

For anyone running a page built on reposted clips and screenshots: that is the whole growth engine, switched off.

The flip side is the opportunity. Instagram recommends the original version and replaces identical reposts. Being the person who made the thing is now a distribution advantage, not just a moral one.

And "original" is a lower bar than it sounds. Your own face, your own screen recording, your own client story, your own numbers. Badly shot and yours beats polished and borrowed.

Make it yours. That's the cheat code now.

📌 DM me the word AUDIT and I'll send you the 20-minute version, or grab it from the link in my bio.
